abstract: The design of the interior surface of a studio or review room for acoustical control is partly a matter of science and partly the exercise of an art. A specified reverberation characteristic can be obtained with fair accuracy, but other problems are solved mainly by judgment. Several examples will be discussed where it was attempted to maintain as high a ratio of engineering to rule-of-thumb as possible.
